kind: engineering diagnostics, not a formal backtest
selection_rule: All eight dates with closing-auction capture in the indexed snapshot; tick case studies choose the first two SH and first SZ symbols by ascending symbol in the current interest pool, independently of returns.
tick_files: Only the three predetermined symbols on the eight dates; inventory other filenames without reading their content.
questions: Does archived raw tick data exist and preserve capture time?
Do captured execution quotes respect submission-window, age and availability constraints?
Are any archived order rows actual broker fills?
Does current per-symbol execution enforce full-account position caps?
Does sizing include fees and does the shadow account settle by product-specific exchange calendar?
